integrity: Analytic semidefinite proof with explicit dual construction, boundary treatment, strict primal feasibility, uniqueness and spectral-multiplicity analysis; finite exact checks supplement but do not certify universally quantified mathematical claims.
scientific_limitations: Exact for positive masses, positive per-edge prices, reversible continuous-time generators on a star with at least three leaves, and one linear purchase budget. Discrete-time SLEM, vertex-mass degeneracy and capped individual rates are excluded. Priority relative to all inaccessible historical literature is not certified.
title: Stationary-mass polygon threshold for price-optimal continuous-time star mixing
